name: Eye of Methuselah

pages.text: Defeat Methuselah in its temple and use the eye to activate a complete Forgotten Portal.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: Find the Temple to Methuselah in jungle biomes. Explore the structure and reach the Methuselah boss.

pages.title: How to obtain
pages.text: Defeat Methuselah. Its installed death logic drops one Eye of Methuselah. The item has no crafting-grid recipe and is not a journal reward.

pages.title: How to use
pages.text: Find a Forgotten Portal. Complete its archstone pillars and use four matching era corners: Paleogene, Neogene or Pleistocene. Use the eye on the finished frame to open the selected epoch.

jem_summary: Defeat Methuselah in its temple and use the eye to activate a complete Forgotten Portal.
